{{Short description|Stage of the 2022 Copa Sudamericana}}
The '''2022 Copa Sudamericana first stage''' was played from 8 to 17 March 2022.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2022_16_ago_2021.pdf|title=Calendario 2022: CONMEBOL Libertadores, CONMEBOL Sudamericana y la CONMEBOL Recopa|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=16 August 2021|language=es}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the first stage to decide 16 of the 32 places in the [[2022 Copa Sudamericana group stage|group stage]] of the [[2022 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/documentos/manual-de-clubes-reglamento-conmebol-sudamericana-2022/|title=Manual de Clubes / Reglamento CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the first stage was held on 20 December 2021, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref name="First stage draw">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/pautas-para-los-sorteos-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2022|title=Pautas para los sorteos de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=17 December 2021|language=es}}</ref><ref name="fixture">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/es/cruces-emocionantes-en-la-primera-fase-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2022|title=Cruces emocionantes en la Primera Fase de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2022|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=20 December 2021|language=es}}</ref> For the first stage, the 32 teams involved were divided into eight pots according to their national association.

The 32 teams were drawn into 16 ties, with the four teams from each national association being drawn against a rival from the same association in two ties per association and the first team drawn in each tie hosting the second leg.<ref name="Draw methodology">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/pautas_del_sorteo_fase_preliminar_conmebol_sudamericana_2022.pdf|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA 2022 PAUTAS DEL SORTEO FASE PRELIMINAR|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|access-date=17 December 2021|language=es}}</ref><section end=Draw />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the first stage, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis. If tied on aggregate, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] was not played, and a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] was used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 2.4.2).<ref name="regulations"/>

The 16 winners of the first stage advanced to the [[2022 Copa Sudamericana group stage|group stage]] to join the 12 teams directly qualified for that stage (six from Argentina and six from Brazil), and four teams transferred from the [[2022 Copa Libertadores|Copa Libertadores]] (the four [[2022 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages#Third stage|teams]] eliminated in the [[2022 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages#Third stage|third stage]] of [[2022 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages|qualifying]]).<section end=Format />

==Matches==
The first legs were played on 8–10 March, while the second legs were played on 15–17 March 2021.<ref name="fixture"/><ref name="fixture pdf">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/fixture_conmebol_sudamericana_primera_fase.pdf|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA 2022 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones Versión de 20/12/2021|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|access-date=21 December 2021|language=es}}</ref>
